results.title: Chinese scholar highlights role of parliamentary ties in Vietnam–China relations
results.description: Professor Mi Liang described parliamentary ties as an important component of the Vietnam–China Comprehensive Strategic Cooperative Partnership, providing a legal foundation for bilateral cooperation, strengthening political trust and reinforcing the social foundations of relations. Vietnamese students place confidence in Vietnam-China cooperation Vietnam, China seek stronger substantive parliamentary cooperation Parliamentary diplomacy strengthens Vietnam-China political trust

results.title: US-brokered ceasefire was supposed to end the war in Gaza. A year later, progress has stalled
results.description: It’s been a year since a ceasefire deal brokered by U.S. President Donald Trump and Arab allies promised to end the war in Gaza, and Israel is still launching deadly strikes on the devastated territory.
